subject: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Chen <rebecca@edgeretailer.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-03-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling

Hi Rebecca,

Great talking earlier — thanks for outlining the usage ramp you expect over the next 12 months. Per our conversation, I put together a short proposal that bumps the monthly hosted commit from 1M tokens to 3M tokens and layers a staged soft-limit / burst policy so you get predictable unit economics while keeping headroom for seasonal spikes.

Attached: EdgeRetailer_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal + ops runbook). I also attached the redline we discussed as a PDF for faster review (redline_contract_v2.pdf). The commercial highlights:
- Monthly committed tokens: 3,000,000 (12-month term)
- Base rate: $0.0008 / token for committed usage; overage bands apply above committed amount with soft throttling starting at 105%
- Soft-limit behavior: automated notification at 95%, soft throttle (grace routing to cheaper variant) at 105% for up to 72 hours, then hard throttle at 120% unless auto-burst is enabled

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Quick internal signoff from legal (I've cc'd Jordan and Vanessa)
2) DocuSign send for the redline contract (I can initiate as soon as Contracts@EdgeRetailer confirms)
3) Ops kickoff: schedule a 30-minute handoff with our Dedicated/Hosted onboarding team the week after signature to lock in rate-limit windows and caching/batching recommendations

Can you confirm if your procurement team needs any PO or special invoice cadence? Also, are there any additional security artifacts you still need (SOC2 evidence, IP allowlist steps)?

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stub: EdgeRetailer_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (pdf)
Attachment stub: redline_contract_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Rebecca Chen <rebecca@edgeretailer.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@edgeretailer.com>
Date: 2029-03-16T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling

Thanks, Sergio — this looks good at a high level.

Quick clarifying Qs from procurement and engineering:
- Procurement: we typically pay net-30 and need a PO before signature. No special invoice cadence beyond that.
- Engineering: can you confirm expected p50/p95 latency targets remain the same with the higher commit and burst routing? We need assurance the new soft-throttle will not add more than ~30ms median latency for chat endpoints.

I'll loop in our legal if the redline is final; otherwise Contracts will request a few tweaks. We can also do the ops kickoff the week after signature — available windows are 3/25 or 3/26 in the US/PST afternoon.

—Rebecca
Director Product, EdgeRetailer
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-03-16T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling

Sergio — quick internal notes from my side after skimming the proposal and redline.
- Commercial: the $0.0008 committed rate is acceptable but request approval to offer a 3-month ramp discount (10% off month 1-3) to smooth initial overage risk.
- Legal redline: Contracts will likely ask to shorten the auto-burst window from 72 to 48 hours; ask Vanessa to evaluate operational impact.
- Ops: we should pre-configure a cache-prefix policy for the top 40% of their request shapes and propose quantization on the non-chat models to reduce token spend for embedding-heavy workloads.

If Rebecca's procurement needs a PO before signature, we can add a payment clause 'invoice on PO receipt; net-30'. I'll wait for Vanessa to confirm on burst window.

—Jordan
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-03-17T08:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling

Jordan / Sergio — ops POV: reducing auto-burst to 48h is fine; it reduces financial exposure and still gives EdgeRetailer time to address a sustained spike. Operational items to include in the DocuSign SOW/attachment:
- Scheduled cache-warm window (24h before seasonal campaigns)
- Batching and prefix cache configuration (we will supply recommended configs and a small client library snippet)
- Monitoring thresholds and escalation playbook (pager at 110% sustained for >1h)

I'll prepare a short Ops SOW blurb to attach to the contract (2 pages) and the onboarding calendar invite template. Also flag: if they want auto-burst beyond 48h we require a committed uplift approval and revenue ops sign-off.

—Vanessa
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Contracts <contracts@edgeretailer.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Rebecca Chen <rebecca@edgeretailer.com>
Date: 2029-03-17T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: EdgeRetailer hosted commit uptick + soft limit scheduling

Hi team,

We've reviewed the redline_contract_v2.pdf. A couple of comments:
1) Please add a PO clause 'Customer will issue PO within 7 days of signature; invoice references PO number'.
2) We request that the soft-throttle fallback preserve request order for in-flight sessions (important for consistency in chat flows).
3) We need an export of audit logs for the past 6 months on request for compliance.

If Redwood can accept these, we'll sign and return via DocuSign. Can you send the final DocuSign envelope with the two attachments and the Ops SOW?

Regards,
